INSERT INTO ops.workflow_audit (workflow_name, workflow_id, execution_id, channel, status, started_at, tenant_id, correlation_id, metadata_json)
VALUES ('{{ $json.workflow_name }}', '{{ $json.workflow_id }}', '{{ $json.execution_id }}', '{{ $json.channel }}', 'started', '{{ $json.started_at }}'::timestamptz, {{ $json.tenant_id ? "'" + $json.tenant_id + "'" : "NULL" }}, {{ $json.correlation_id ? "'" + $json.correlation_id + "'" : "NULL" }}, '{{ JSON.stringify($json.metadata_json) }}'::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
RETURNING id

UPDATE ops.workflow_audit
SET status = '{{ $json.status }}',
    completed_at = '{{ $json.completed_at }}'::timestamptz,
    duration_ms = {{ $json.duration_ms !== null ? $json.duration_ms : 'NULL' }},
    error_message = {{ $json.error_message ? "'" + $json.error_message.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }}
WHERE execution_id = '{{ $json.execution_id }}'
  AND status = 'started'
RETURNING id
